Innisfree

Milk Dunk

Pop Up Mob introduced Innisfree's Ceramide Milk through the Milk Dunk, a live dunk-tank moment where participants aimed to drop a model into a tank of “milk,” turning hydration into spectacle and naturally drawing a crowd that flowed straight into Sephora to discover the product up close.
